finalized_content: The Eleventh Law of Camelot-OS is the Absolute Zero-Docker Bare-Metal Mandate: Docker and heavy container virtualization runtimes are outlawed across sovereign nodes. All kinetic execution must run as pure native bare-metal systemd services, Rust, Go, Zig, or WASM microVM sandboxes within the 4.0 GB RAM boundary to eliminate virtualization overhead, socket bloat, and memory thrashing.
